text:
Rhea Kapoor: Quick sync  we need a short cost-focused readout for Meridian ahead of renewal. Request: 30/60/90 token snapshot, embed pilot uplift scenarios, any onboarding blockers affecting spend, and a recommended contingency credit. Can someone pull numbers?

Tom Alvarez: I got this. Pulling hosted + dedicated breakdowns. Any preference for scenario definitions?

Rhea Kapoor: Conservative/medium/upside. Call out embed conversion sensitivity and one-off spike sources.

Jin Park: Note: their analytics job increased seq length twice last month. Log shows two runs with 3.2k prompt length. Could explain a 28% day spike. Recommend adding an avg tokens/request alert >1.1k.

Tom Alvarez: Draft metrics:
30d: 39.6M tokens (hosted 36.8M / dedic-embed 2.8M)
60d: 75.1M
90d: 113.4M
Run-rate: ~1.27M tokens/day
Baseline 90d forecast: 120-150M tokens
Cost delta vs prior qtr: +9-14%

Marta Ruiz: Onboarding blocker: their client onboarding script failed for new OAuth clients for 10 days -> delayed seat activation ~22%. Tracking fix ETA: 12 days. Ill add that to slide notes.

Tom Alvarez: Scenarios Ill produce: conservative=no embed uplift; medium=30% text->embed conversion; upside=60% conversion + onboarding completes. Ill include token-to-embed unit mapping and cost per unit.

Rhea Kapoor: Also compute a "procurement stress" metric: pct variance vs renewal quarter. If >15% flag escalation and suggest credit band.

Jin Park: Suggest auto-guard: quota cap on nightly jobs (concurrency=6) and alert: single-day tokens > 2.5x median -> page.

Tom Alvarez: Quick sensitivity sketch: medium scenario pushes 90d to ~170M tokens; upside ~210M. Hitting the 350M annualized tier would lower blended unit cost ~9%.

Rhea Kapoor: Good. For executive ask, propose a 1) small adjustment credit ($7k-$18k) and 2) short-term invoice buffer if spike traces to platform change. Legal can sign-off later.

Marta Ruiz: Ill quantify seat reactivation uplift over 3/6 week horizons and add to the deck.

cs-bot: Reminder: QBR template: https://redwood.company/qbr-templates (use "budget-risk" and "mitigations").

Tom Alvarez: Action items:
- Tom: slides + three scenarios by Mon 9am PT (2864089600)
- Jin: add alert + quota guard playbook text by Mon EOD
- Marta: onboarding uplift timelines + notes by Mon noon
- Rhea: finalize exec ask and upload by Tue noon

Jin Park: Tested small throttle on staging for the analytics job: batch=256 -> token-cost -16%, latency +8ms. Will paste logs in drive.

Tom Alvarez: Uploaded draft deck: https://drive.redwood/meridian/qbr-draft please comment.

Rhea Kapoor: Ill lead the readout. Thanks folks thumbsup: Closing unless anything else pops up.
